$comment: Backend contract for LLMProxy2 shared Admin UI and Node communication across hub, lite, and full roles.
$changelog: v3.4: full-node objects carry admin_password (full role only; plaintext in Hub KV by explicit operator choice — Plan A — so the console password is re-viewable; lite nodes never have the field, and patching full→lite drops it); added nodes_credentials (GET /api/admin/nodes/:id/credentials, read-only re-view of the stored admin password + recoverable client key, Cache-Control: no-store, never rotates the token); admin auth accepts URL query-string credentials (?key/?token/?password) on the full-role admin plane by explicit operator tradeoff — see auth_semantics.query_string_credentials.

v3.3: providers.rpm_per_key is the provider's OVERALL RPM ceiling enforced scheduler-side as one provider-wide sliding window (0 = unlimited) and no longer falls back into the per-key check — api_keys[].max_rpm keeps its key-level meaning; probe_models documents api_type and stored-key resolution (empty/masked api_key resolves the provider's first enabled stored key, vault-managed keys refuse base_url overrides with 403); added test_agent_model and test_candidate (the route-line 测试路由 endpoints, full role only).

v3.2: GET /api/admin/presets-extra preset objects carry version/updated_at mirroring the provider's adapter file (shared/presets/<id>.json); both fields are omitted when the preset has no matching adapter file.

v3: removed POST /api/vault/sync (full sync replaced by on-demand fetch); POST /api/vault/fetch gains 409 provider_exists_local, wholesale replace of hub-managed fields on re-fetch, and imported_keys; GET /api/vault/manifest gains the agent_models route-template section; both endpoints now serve hub and full roles.

v3.1: vault fetch no longer accepts caller-supplied hub_url/node_token (target is always the stored vault config; anti-exfiltration); provider_config gains api_type/rule_hash and no longer touches enabled; manifest candidates rename max_conc to max_concurrency and rule_hash is hub-computed from adapter_rules; /api/vault/manifest accepts POST (credentials in body instead of the query string); provider IDs with unsafe characters are refused at adoption.

response.nodes: array of node objects (each full-role node carries admin_password in plaintext — operator-accepted Plan A; lite nodes carry no admin_password field)

response.node: object (full-role node includes admin_password, plaintext — stored in Hub KV so it stays re-viewable)
response.admin_password: string (full role only; absent for lite)
string (full role only; the KV-stored password is REUSED across rotations — only a legacy node issued before passwords were persisted gets one minted here, and that mint is persisted)
string | null (full role: the KV-stored plaintext; null for lite or a legacy node that never stored one)
response.client_key: string | null (the Hub's global settings.client_key when configured — issuance embeds it on every node; null when the Hub has no global client key configured, i.e. the node got a one-off random key that was never persisted)
response.admin_password_note: string (optional; present for lite nodes, or when a legacy full node has no stored password)
response.client_key_note: string (optional; present when the Hub has no global client key configured)

nodes_credentials.semantics: read-only re-view of the admin console password (node list rows' 密码 button): NEVER rotates the node token; Cache-Control: no-store (the body carries a plaintext credential). Legacy full nodes issued before passwords were stored answer with a note; re-obtaining the install command (which rotates the token) mints and persists one.

response.admin_password: string (full role only; the KV-stored password is reused — minted and persisted only for legacy nodes that never stored one)

nodes_install_command.semantics: rotates the node token internally (old token invalidated immediately); the admin password is NOT rotated (KV-stored value reused); Cache-Control: no-store

request.base_url: string (optional; required when neither the provider nor its preset carries a base_url)
request.api_key: string (optional: empty or masked resolves the provider's first enabled stored key; the hub additionally accepts key_label to pick a specific stored key)
request.api_type: string (optional: anthropic-messages switches the probe to x-api-key + anthropic-version headers)

response.models: array of strings (upstream GET /models ids; OpenAI {data:[{id}]} and Google {models:[{name}]} shapes both parse, the models/ prefix is stripped)

errors.400: invalid json / base_url required / (hub) api_key_required, cannot_probe_with_masked_key, unsafe_upstream_url
errors.401: api key is empty or unresolvable (full)
errors.403: cannot override base_url when using a vault-managed key (full)
errors.4xx-5xx: upstream non-2xx status is passed through with ok:false (full)

probe_models.semantics: backbone of the add-model flow (选供应商 → 探测上游模型 → 点选/手填 target_model)：the probe never mutates config, it only lists the upstream model ids the admin can pick from

params.hub_url: string (optional, full node only: hub override; POST body on POST, query string on GET)
params.node_token: string (optional, full node only: node token override; POST body on POST, query string on GET — POST preferred so the token stays out of access logs)

<provider_id>.name: string
<provider_id>.rule_hash: string (hub-computed content hash of the resolved adapter_rules; the node compares it with the hash it stored on fetch to detect rule drift)

vault_manifest.semantics: hub-managed manifest, metadata only (key labels, never plaintext). providers lists vault providers (origin=local excluded) with enabled key labels that carry key material (mirrors the routing projection); node tokens additionally see only their provider scope. rule_hash is computed hub-side from the same resolved adapter_rules that /api/vault/fetch returns, so a node can detect rule drift. agent_models are on-demand route templates: enabled routes only, filtered by the caller's model scope, and every candidate must reference a provider that survived into this manifest's providers section (dead candidates culled, a route with none left is dropped). Candidates carry key labels (key_label) and the per-candidate max_concurrency cap, not key material.

request.key_label: string (optional: fetch a single key by label)
request.keys: array of strings (optional: fetch key labels as a subset)

provider_config.name: string
provider_config.rule_hash: string (same hub-computed hash the manifest publishes)
provider_config.keys: object (label -> key material; masked in the full-node echo)

response.imported_keys: array of key-label strings (added by the full node on 200: vault keys that landed with this fetch)

errors.400: invalid_json / provider_required / vault hub url not configured
errors.403: provider_out_of_node_scope (hub, node token out of provider scope)

409.when: full node only: the target provider already exists locally with origin=local or a legacy empty origin (delete or rename it first); re-checked under the config lock at import time

errors.502: hub unreachable, or hub returned 200 with a body that is not a JSON object (never echoed unmasked)

vault_fetch.semantics: on-demand single-provider fetch (replaces the removed full-sync POST /api/vault/sync). The fetch target is ALWAYS the configured vault (stored config URL + node token, or CLI defaults) — callers cannot override hub_url/node_token on this endpoint, so an admin-password leak cannot repoint the auto-import at an attacker hub. A full provider fetch (no key_label/keys) replaces the hub-managed fields (name/base_url/anthropic_base_url/adapter_rules/preset_id/api_type/hide_client_name/rule_hash) and the vault key list wholesale on the full node: keys deleted locally reappear and keys removed on the hub disappear. Provider enabled and per-key enabled are local operational toggles and are never taken from the payload. A key-label subset fetch (key_label or keys present) merges without dropping the other vault keys. Vault keys land with origin=vault; providers with a local/legacy-empty origin and local keys are never overwritten. The full node auto-imports the fetched provider and masks plaintext key material before echoing the hub response.

request.key_label: string (optional, alias key: empty resolves the provider's first enabled stored key)
request.type: string (optional: chat | embedding | reranker | ocr, default chat; alias category)
request.model: string (optional, alias model_name/agent_model: empty resolves from kb_models[type] for this provider, then the provider's model aliases, then falls back to the type name)

response.status: integer (upstream HTTP status, 502 on transport error)
response.text: string (chat answer content, or the first ≤100 bytes of the body when the shape is unrecognized)
response.error: string (optional, upstream body capped at 200 chars)

test_candidate.semantics: single-candidate probe used by the route-line 测试路由 button for embedding/reranker/ocr: embedding → POST {base}/embeddings {model, input:test}; reranker → POST {base}/rerank {model, query:test, documents:[a]}; ocr → chat/completions with a 1×1 png + Extract text, max_tokens 64; chat → the same minimal inference as test_agent_model (messages [{role:user, content:Hi}], max_tokens 16). A passing probe clears the key's cooldown.

response.ok: boolean (true when at least one candidate passed)
response.results: array of {provider, key, model, ok, status, latency_ms, error?}

test_agent_model.semantics: route-line 测试路由 for chat-style routes: fires one minimal real inference per enabled candidate (all candidates when none enabled) — POST {base}/chat/completions {model: target_model||model, messages:[{role:user, content:Hi}], max_tokens:16, stream:false} (anthropic-messages providers target {base}/messages without stream), up to 5 probes in parallel with a 15s timeout; a passing probe clears that key's cooldown. The UI reports the fastest passing candidate (provider + key + latency).

response.presets: array of preset objects (PresetDef); each may carry version/updated_at mirroring the provider's adapter file shared/presets/<id>.json — omitted (omitempty) when the preset has no matching adapter file

provider_config_semantics.rpm_per_key: 该供应商整体 RPM 上限（调度器按供应商维度限流），0=不限：>0 时调度器在派发前先对整个供应商（独立 RPMLimiter 实例 providerRPMLimiter 的桶 provider:<provider_id>，与 Key 级桶 provider:key_label 分属两个实例，命名空间不相交由构造保证）做一次滑动窗口 TryAcquire，窗口满则该供应商全部 Key 一律不再派发（isCandidateHealthy 排序期判不健康与 Dispatch / ExecuteEndpoint 候选遍历两处一致，跳过原因记 <provider_id> (provider RPM limit)，相同供应商去重）。Key 级拒绝、OAuth 刷新或请求构建等拨号前失败会退回已取的供应商令牌（TryAcquireToken/Release 语义），窗口只统计真实发出的请求。不再回退进 Key 级检查——N 把 Key 不会各拿一份整供应商额度。internal/scheduler/rpm.go providerRPMKey()/TryAcquireToken()、internal/scheduler/scheduler.go、internal/scheduler/high_conc.go。
provider_config_semantics.max_rpm: Key 级 RPM 上限（api_keys[].max_rpm），语义不变、独立生效：仅约束该 Key 自身的滑动窗口（桶 provider:key_label），0=不限；调度顺序为先查供应商窗口、再查 Key 窗口。

query_string_credentials.scope: full-role admin plane only (internal/auth/auth.go VerifyAdminAuth): URL query params ?key= / ?token= / ?password=; priority header > key > token > password. The /v1/* data plane (VerifyClientKey) is NOT header-only and never was: its ExtractToken already falls back to ?key= / ?token= query params when no header credential is present (header > key > token) — a pre-existing behavior predating this change. It never reads ?password= and never accepts adminPassword.
query_string_credentials.risk_accepted_by_operator: 私有部署便利性取舍，用户明确接受：凭据出现在 URL 中可能进入浏览器历史、Referrer 头与反向代理访问日志。 Hub 中枢的 HTTP API 未放宽（checkAdminAuth 仍只收 Authorization/x-admin-key 头）；?key= 直登（读取 URL 参数自动填充登录表单并经正常登录路径提交）只在 Full 控制台实现，Hub 控制台不支持查询串直登——前端读取参数后立即从地址栏抹除（history.replaceState，无论登录成败、无论 full/hub），凭据不长期驻留 URL。
query_string_credentials.bruteforce_budget: a WRONG query-string credential fails and consumes the anti-bruteforce budget exactly like a wrong header (5 wrong attempts in 10 minutes lock the IP). Accepted amplification for this private deployment: the full console auto-submits a ?key= page load, so malicious links carrying guessed params can remotely burn the operator IP's budget (DoS only, no credential gain; server-side lockout auto-expires after 10 minutes).

failure_locked.when: IP locked after 5 wrong credentials within 10 minutes

credential_less_requests.reason: page loads and probes must not consume the anti-bruteforce budget

client_key_visibility.reason: admin needs the value to configure gateway clients
